title: Si/Al2O3 23-Layer Dual-Cavity Filter with Corrected Thickness Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Adding one outer quarter-wave layer to the converged 22-layer Si/Al2O3 dual-cavity design while expanding thickness bounds by 15% will maintain or improve target score above 0.85 while eliminating the initialization-out-of-bounds compilation error.
design_principle: Embed the iteration_15 best candidate thicknesses (22 layers) as inner core, add one outer Si layer initialized to quarter-wave at 3.3 um central wavelength (~550 nm), expand bounds from 400-1100 nm to 400-1265 nm to accommodate gradient steps without hard-boundary clipping.
proposed_topology: Air | [Si/Al2O3]_11 with dual defect cavities | Si outer layer | CaF2 substrate; total 23 finite layers
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands
Minimize mean transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds 400-1265 nm accommodate deposition tolerance
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack principle for alternating high/low index dielectrics
Defect cavity engineering for dual-band transmission
Thickness bound expansion to prevent optimization boundary clipping
expected_advantages: Outer layer may improve antireflection at air interface
15% bound expansion allows gradient optimizer more freedom
known_risks: Additional layer may introduce spectral ripple
Outer layer optimization may perturb inner cavity resonance
Material absorption in Si at longer wavelengths
execution_request_english: Design a 23-layer planar multilayer filter on CaF2 substrate at normal incidence. Layer sequence: Air | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | CaF2. Initialize inner 22 layers with thicknesses from iteration_15 best candidate [502, 538, 621, 599, 496, 583, 612, 497, 535, 545, 906, 627, 613, 510, 545, 606, 629, 1017, 461, 450, 576, 865] nm, initialize outer layer (layer 1) to 550 nm quarter-wave at 3.3 um. Thickness optimization bounds: 400-1265 nm for all layers. Optimize for high transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands, low transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 2500-3100 nm, 3250-3350 nm, 4200-4300 nm, 4450-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands; Low transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 24; No metal layers; Conventional depositable infrared inorganic dielectric materials only.
revision_reason: Fix iteration_18 compilation error (initial thickness outside bounds) by expanding bounds 15% and adding outer layer per feedback directive. Embed iteration_15 converged 22-layer thicknesses as inner core.
